summary: The mandatory filter forces an error if a variable is undefined, rather than it being ignored or skipped.
questions: How do I make a playbook fail if a required variable isn't set?
How do I force an error on undefined variables?

answer_card.title: mandatory filter
answer_card.answer_md: Depending on context, undefined variables can be ignored or skipped. `{{ myvar | mandatory }}` forces an **error** if the variable isn't defined.
